QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is also off by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`)... so the "off" reading likely comes from a commented-out `#define`. Confirm against the header."

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither. It hedges on the commented-out `#define` but still states the substance.
